description: Failures McDonald's hit on the OH board during launch-by-launch bring-up (2026-09-18), in the order they surfaced. Each names the map row that should have flagged it before any launch.

blockers.symptom: 0 of 10 packaged libraries load: the OH linker cannot map lib/arm64-v8a/*.so out of the APK
libraries fail to link on bionic-only symbols (__sF, __pthread_cleanup_push, __system_property_foreach, isnan, ...)
libakamaibmp.so self-traps with an uncatchable SIGILL on load
density-split drawables not found: split APKs invisible to resources
Realm: Failed to create fifo ... Permission denied (13)
blockers.fix: none yet: board run permissive; policy rule or data_app_el2_file label needed

blockers.symptom: Firebase Instance ID component is not present (component discovery found no registrars)
no content provider from the manifest is created before Application.onCreate (Firebase, Forter, ML Kit initializers never run)
blockers.fix: default ComponentInfo.processName to the application's process (westlake 4993809)
blockers.found_by: probes/provider-manifest on 2026-09-21, before any McDonald's launch reached it

blockers.symptom: ActivityManager.getRunningAppProcesses() and getRunningServices() return null; Kochava AppUtil iterates both unchecked
blockers.fix: answer with the caller's own process (westlake f4e0366)

blockers.symptom: sign-in activity reached and drawing, screen white: the sign-in bottom sheet, a dialog shown before the activity's window, is stacked under that window
blockers.fix: hold a dialog's OH session back until its activity's window has one (westlake 5df440b, Java only)
blockers.found_by: first McDonald's launch on the rebuilt stack, 2026-09-22; reproduced by probes/dialog-before-window; map row added after the fact

blockers.symptom: dialogs drawn at the top-left instead of centred; taps on a moved window missed it
blockers.fix: place by WindowLayout and route touches to the window under the pointer (westlake f6dc615)
blockers.found_by: sign-in screenshot, 2026-09-22; row read from the window adapter source

blockers.symptom: nothing dimmed behind a FLAG_DIM_BEHIND dialog
blockers.fix: dim layer window under the dimming window (westlake f6dc615)
blockers.found_by: sign-in screenshot, 2026-09-22; row read from the window adapter source

blockers.symptom: focusing the email field shows no keyboard: liboh_ime_helper_capi.so is not in the staged runtime (dlopen errno 2)
blockers.fix: source-built helper added to the runtime (westlake tools/build_native.py, byte-identical to earlier builds)
blockers.found_by: tap on the email field, 2026-09-22. No row: the map does not check that Westlake's own helper libraries are staged

blockers.symptom: the keyboard covers the focused field: the occupied area was measured against a dialog window's own size and applied to the reporting window
blockers.fix: IME insets on the focused window against the physical display (westlake f6dc615)
blockers.found_by: typing test, 2026-09-22. No row: an IME-insets probe is the missing check

blockers.symptom: with the WebView supplied, Akamai's libakamaibmp.so loads and kills the process with SIGILL
blockers.fix: source-built bionic shim with the loader refusal replaces the captured copy (manifest 66853c2)
blockers.found_by: launch with the WebView input, 2026-09-22 (B3 again, through a stale shim)

blockers.symptom: a finished activity is never destroyed in direct launch; its window stays in the window list
blockers.fix: local DestroyActivityItem when no OH ability stands behind the activity (westlake 4fbb09b)
blockers.found_by: window list during the sign-in run, 2026-09-22. No row: an activity-finish probe is the missing check
